0002-history-store.md: Records each design token's resolved value per test run and reports when a token's value shifts from what earlier runs stored.
0008-locale-runs.md: Renders one UI state in several languages during a run and compares each translation against the base-language rendering for untranslated or overflowing text.
0011-storage-and-cache-primitives.md: Lets the person configuring the tool choose where cached renderings are stored, separately from where accepted reference images are kept.
0012-order-dependence-in-a-run.md: Re-captures a changed UI state on a fresh page and reports differences that vanish there as caused by earlier tests, not regressions.
0013-a-real-agent.md: Keeps a coding agent's previous capture of a UI state and answers its next capture with the difference, naming the responsible component and line.
0014-hosted-who-the-caller-is-and-what-t: Derives the project and the approving person from the presented access token, so the hosted review service records who accepted each image.
0019-provenance-without-react.md: Attributes rendered elements to their Vue or Svelte source components on a real application, using attributes the framework's compiler already emits.
0022-evidence-from-code-this-project-did: Measures false alarms by running the comparison over a third-party component library after deliberate harmless refactors, counting spurious detected changes.
0024-what-a-prop-controls.md: Hashes each component input property separately, so a comparison can name which specific prop changed when a component renders differently.
0028-the-instrument.md: Inserts tiny tracking calls into source code and runs tests to record which code regions each test file entered.
0029-what-a-run-remembers.md: Tracks whether stored per-test coverage is complete and current before allowing any test to be skipped on its basis.
0031-a-contract-is-a-subject.md: Stores API schemas and JSON values as comparable items, feeding them to existing diff tools that classify breaking changes between versions.
0036-a-journey-crosses-processes.md: Links a component's network request to the server file that handles it, so a code change on either side selects tests across services.
0037-a-closure-per-node.md: Computes a hash over each component and everything nested under it, so identical whole subtrees can be matched across pages.
0040-a-baseline-in-git-is-a-picture.md: Stores only reference images in version control and moves their metadata to a separate store, treating missing metadata as recoverable rather than corrupt.
0042-a-start-point-is-a-path-sense-holds: Limits a search to files importable from, or importing, a given real file path in the repository's dependency graph.
0043-a-record-costs-what-the-run-cost.md: Writes coverage results in memory proportional to the tests just run, not to the whole repository's stored coverage file.
0044-many-writers-one-record.md: Serializes concurrent writers merging into one shared coverage file with a proper lock, and reports any contribution that gets dropped.
0045-a-snapshot-states-its-own-age.md: Adds identifying bytes, a version and checksums to the stored coverage file so readers distinguish foreign, outdated and corrupted files.
Computes the safe list of skippable tests once inside the library, instead of every caller subtracting coverage sets itself.
Measures how much of a test suite selection removes and how often it wrongly omits a failing test, using mutation experiments.
0048-a-worker-that-dies-says-so.md: Writes each worker's coverage file durably and reads files individually, so one damaged file names itself instead of failing the whole test run.
0049-nothing-can-ask-the-record-where-it: Answers which tests pass through a given file, function or line of code, using stored per-test coverage data.
0051-a-sensitivity-is-scoped-by-id-and-n: Lets strictness settings apply to parts of a page, such as one component, rather than only to the whole page by name.
Discards each captured page's full DOM tree once processed, keeping memory bounded instead of holding every tree until the run ends.
0053-a-surface-inside-a-suite-reaches-le: Writes before, after and diff images plus stored results from visual checks embedded inside Playwright or Vitest tests.
0055-a-workspace-import-resolves-to-its-: Resolves imports of monorepo packages to their original source files by tracing compiler output settings backwards, whether or not built output exists.
0056-a-session-daemon-keeps-the-index-cu: Runs a background process that listens to git's file-system monitor and triggers updates of the stored per-file index as files change.
0059-a-change-runs-the-cases-that-ran-it: Selects the individual test cases that executed changed code and passes them to the test runner's own name filter.
0061-a-depends-directive-takes-a-glob.md: Expands a wildcard pattern in a source dependency comment into dependency links to every matching git-tracked file.
0062-a-suite-says-which-files-reach-it.m: Lets each test suite declare which file kinds, like images, do not trigger its tests, and prints every such exclusion.
0063-an-editor-asks-about-the-text-it-ho: Runs a long-lived service a code editor queries for everything known about each line of its open, possibly unsaved, file.
0067-a-case-carries-its-outcome.md: Stores each test case's pass or fail status, failure message, location and duration alongside its recorded coverage.
0068-an-edit-runs-what-it-reaches-from-t: Runs the tests affected by a saved edit from the code editor, nearest first, streaming each outcome into the editor gutter.
Marks, inside the code editor, code regions a test change stopped executing, naming the test file that no longer enters them.
0071-a-test-is-read-alone.md: Adds an editor toggle showing only the lines the most recently run test file executed, instead of the whole suite's coverage.
0072-a-case-read-two-ways-is-compared-wi: Records a test case's coverage under a second execution order and compares both, flagging cases whose executed code depends on leftover state.
0074-what-ci-derived-is-reachable-from-a: Fetches the latest main branch's CI reports, images and coverage data into a local checkout for local tools to query.
0079-shards-steal-from-each-other.md: Distributes test file groups from one shared queue across parallel CI machines, so faster machines take remaining work from slower ones.
0080-coverage-is-counted-per-kind.md: Writes the per-suite coverage change table to the CI job summary and keeps a coverage trend over time.
0081-the-tech-stack-is-read-from-the-cod: Lists the third-party packages the code actually imports, the local wrappers used around them, and the in-house foundation modules other code depends on.
0087-every-suite-is-compared-with-its-ow: Accepts a separate comparison file for each test suite, so coverage changes are reported per suite even when some lack one.
0088-a-suite-is-carried-alone.md: Saves and restores each test suite's coverage data in its own CI cache directory, so restoring one never overwrites another.
0089-this-repository-reports-every-kind-: Configures this repository's CI to record unit, visual and end-to-end suite coverage and compare all three on pull requests.
